integrity: Finite numerical checks are auxiliary; proof is analytic and includes a uniform lattice-to-continuum estimate.
scientific_limitations: The limiting variational maximizer is not evaluated in closed form or proved unique.
Relative compactness applies to nonnegative coefficient-modulus step profiles, not complex phase profiles.
Historical priority remains subject to additional specialized Jacobi and compact-group literature.
title: Sharp growing-bandwidth fourth moments of central \(SU(2)\) Fourier polynomials
